entities.summary: SS Arabic, built as Berlin, was an ocean liner launched on 7 November 1908 by the AG Weser shipyard in Germany. She made her maiden voyage on 1 May 1909 from Bremerhaven to New York and Genoa. In September 1914 she became an auxiliary cruiser of the Imperial German Navy as a minelayer.
